Tucker4 forecast on ILR cause-shares

Source: R/tucker4.R
tucker4_coherent_forecast.Rd

Decomposes the 4D ILR tensor, forecasts the B (time) mode, reconstructs, and inverts ILR to produce share forecasts.

Usage

tucker4_coherent_forecast(
  X_ilr,
  years,
  h,
  R_A = 3,
  R_B = 3,
  R_C = 2,
  R_D = 3,
  ts_method = "ets",
  fast = TRUE,
  return_full = FALSE
)

Arguments

X_ilr

4D array [n_a x n_t x n_g x K] of ILR coordinates.

years

Integer vector of observed years.

h

Forecast horizon.

R_A, R_B, R_C, R_D

Tucker4 ranks.

ts_method

"ets", "arima", or "rwd".

fast

Use fast convergence settings?

return_full

Return decomposition components for bootstrap?

Value

List with shares_forecast [n_a x h x n_g x K+1] and fit_pct.
